_comment: Optional fine-tuning after outline-color bounds (#e7a765). Keys: resonance slug, type/resonance, or filename.

_fields.trimLeft: extra pixels to remove from outline bbox left (natural image coords)
_fields.trimRight: extra pixels to remove from outline bbox right
_fields.trimTop: extra pixels to remove from outline bbox top
_fields.trimBottom: extra pixels to remove from outline bbox bottom
_fields.shiftX: nudge cropped graphic horizontally at display size (px, + = right)
_fields.shiftY: nudge cropped graphic vertically at display size (px, + = down)
